_description: Reference AI settings for MicroCMS. Import via: POST /api/v1/sites/{siteId}/config/import
_notes: Secret values (ai:api_key, ai:vector_store:api_key) are NOT included here.
Set them separately via PUT /api/v1/sites/{siteId}/config/{key} with isSecret:true.
Copy this file, fill in your values, then POST the 'entries' array to the import endpoint.

entries._comment: Supported values: azure_openai | openai | ollama | anthropic
Provider API base URL. Azure: https://{resource}.openai.azure.com. OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1
Model identifier. Azure/OpenAI: gpt-4o. Ollama: llama3, mistral. Anthropic: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022
Azure OpenAI only: deployment name. Leave blank for other providers.
Default maximum tokens per completion request.
Sampling temperature (0.0–2.0). Lower = more deterministic. Higher = more creative.
Restrict AI calls to a specific region. E.g. eastus, westeurope. Leave blank to allow any.
Maximum tokens consumed per day across all users of this site. 0 = unlimited.
Monthly cost cap in USD. 0 = unlimited.
Redact PII (emails, phone numbers, SSNs) from user content before sending to provider.
Detect and reject prompt injection attempts in user-supplied content.

entries.value:
You are an expert content writer for a headless CMS. Your task is to generate high-quality, structured content based on the content type schema provided. Follow these rules strictly:
1. Output ONLY valid JSON that matches the provided field schema — no markdown, no explanation.
2. Use professional, engaging language appropriate for the content type.
3. Keep each field within its stated character or word limit.
4. Never invent facts; base all content on the instructions provided.
5. If a field is marked optional and no relevant content exists, output an empty string for that field.
entries._comment: System prompt for entry content generation. Defines role, output format, and quality constraints.
User prompt template for entry content generation. Placeholders: {contentType}, {fieldName}, {instructions}.

entries.value:
You are an SEO specialist. Analyse the provided page content and produce SEO metadata. Follow these rules:
1. Output ONLY valid JSON with the exact fields: metaTitle, metaDescription, focusKeyword, suggestedKeywords, readabilityScore.
2. metaTitle: 50–60 characters, includes focus keyword near the start.
3. metaDescription: 150–160 characters, compelling, includes focus keyword.
4. focusKeyword: single most important keyword phrase.
5. suggestedKeywords: array of 3–5 secondary keyword phrases.
6. readabilityScore: integer 0–100 (Flesch–Kincaid estimate).
7. Do not add markdown, explanations, or any text outside the JSON object.
entries._comment: System prompt for page SEO assistance. Defines output JSON schema and SEO guidelines.
User prompt template for page SEO. Placeholders: {pageTitle}, {pageContent}, {targetKeywords}.
Vector store provider. Supported: pgvector | qdrant. Leave blank to disable RAG.
Embedding model. Ollama: nomic-embed-text. OpenAI: text-embedding-3-small. Azure: text-embedding-ada-002.
